name: Flip Card
description: Two-sided card that flips on click, keyboard or drag with spring physics, plus pointer tilt, moving glare, hover lift and a soft shadow. Front and back accept any React content.
contents: Front face and back face slots that take any React node
Optional glare overlay on each face
Optional blurred ground shadow under the card
behavior: Click, Enter or Space flips the card with a spring rotation
Dragging along the flip axis rotates the card and snaps to front or back using release velocity
Mouse hover tilts the card toward the pointer and moves a glare highlight, then scales up slightly
Works controlled (flipped plus onFlipChange) or uncontrolled (defaultFlipped)
With reduced motion enabled the flip is instant, drag and tilt are off, and faces cross-fade
Hidden face is marked inert and aria-hidden, the card exposes role button with aria-pressed
editableByProps: Front and back content, card size, corner radius, background and text color
Flip direction (horizontal or vertical axis), click and drag flipping, disabled state
Tilt strength, glare on or off and intensity, hover scale, perspective
Spring stiffness and damping, shadow on or off, color and opacity
Controlled or uncontrolled flip state and change callback, aria label, extra class

needsCodeEdit.change: Change the drag release throw strength or touch and mouse drag threshold
needsCodeEdit.where: FLING and SLOP constants at the top of the file

needsCodeEdit.change: Change tilt or hover lift spring feel

needsCodeEdit.where: The radial-gradient span rendered inside each face when glare is true
group-data-[fade] transition classes on the two face divs

fixed: Requires the motion package and Tailwind CSS with arbitrary value and group-data variants support
Card is a fixed pixel width and height (max-width 100%), so tall cards on narrow screens need a smaller width prop
Only two faces, a single flip of 180 degrees per interaction
Tilt and glare follow mouse and pen only, touch gets drag and tap but no tilt
Face background and text color are shared by both faces
Touch scrolling stays enabled on the cross axis (pan-y for y axis, pan-x for x axis)
Works on small screens, drag threshold is larger for touch

options.look: Card spins sideways like a book page around its vertical axis, drag horizontally
options.useWhen: Feature or team card grids where each card reveals details on the back

options.look: Card flips up and over around its horizontal axis, drag vertically
options.useWhen: Flashcard or quiz sections where the answer sits on the back like a turned card
